content.text: Yâgirwa, orhege okurhwiri kwâwe onyumve nâni, bulyâla mpanyagîre nnandi mukenyi.
Omanyire omurhima gwâni, bulya ndi wâwe, ocize mwambali wâwe, bulya we acîkubagîre.
We Nyamuzinda wâni; onfè lukogo mâshi Yâgirwa, obûla ndwîrhe nakukûbiriza burhahusa.
Oshagaluse omurhima gwa mwambali wâwe, bulyâla emund’oli, Nyakasane yo ndengerize omurhima gwâni.
Na bulya Yâgirwa we mwinjà, we n’olukogo lushundwakwo; onaluzize obwonjo oku ngasi boshi bakusengera.
Nyamwagirwa, omusengero gwâni oguyumvîrhize, n’izù ly’omusengero gwâni olirhege okurhwiri.
Nkuyâkûzize olusiku ndi burhè, bulyâla mmanyire oku wanyumvîrhiza.
Abazimu barhalimwo okuhisirekwo, Nyakasane, na ntà mulenga ohisire okw’ikola lyâwe.
Amashanja walemaga goshi, gayisha gakuharâmye, Nyamwagirwa, ganamanyise izîno lyâwe.
Bulya we munênênè we nakola ebirhangaza: wêne we Nyamuzinda.
Muhanyi, onnangûle enjira yâwe nkaz’igera omu kunali kwâwe, ohabûle omurhima gwâni, gukaz’irhînya izîno lyâwe.
Yâgirwa Nyamuzinda, nacîkwitakîra n’omurhima gwâni gwoshi, nnamanyîse izîno lyâwe emyâka n’emyâka.
Bulyâla olukogo lwâwe lwayishir’ibà lunji kuli nie, washâywîre omûka gwâni omu muhengere gw’ekuzimu.
Nyamuzinda, mâshi, balya bagayana bantezire, n’engabo ya balya b’ecikalarhu egungêzize omûka gwâni, barhanakushibiriri ciru w’oyo.
Cabâ wêhe, Nyamwagirwa, we Nyamuzinda w’obwonjo n’olukogo, we Nn’obwinjà bwoshi, orhalubiraho orhanarhebana.
Ndolakwo obwonjo bukugwârhe; oshobôze mwambali wâwe obuzibu bwâwe, onacize mugala wa mwambali-kazi wâwe.
Ompè ecimanyîso c’oburhonyi bwâwe, balya banshomba babone, n’enshonyi zibabumbe, babone oku wantabîre, Nyamwagirwa, wanantûliriza.
